summary: A 60-foot steel ladder tower with an octagonal cab, erected in 1947 in Sherburne County and still listed as standing; visitors report it is not open to climb.

facts.design: 60-foot steel ladder access tower with an octagonal cab

access.note: A visitor listing says the tower is not open to climb to the top and can be seen from its base; no DNR statement found.

events.note: Erected as a 60-foot steel ladder access tower with an octagon cab, per the Forest Lookouts list

evidence.supports: erected 1947 as a 60-foot steel ladder access tower with octagon cab
evidence.quote: 1947: A 60-foot steel ladder access tower with octagon cab erected.

corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts page prints 34N-27-22 under the county name, which reads like a township, range and section location rather than an agency. No agency is named in the sources read.

sources.title: Sand Dunes Lookout Tower, hiking highlight

notes_for_editor: Built year (1947), height and design rest on one inventory page (Forest Lookouts, Minnesota section); the FFLA list confirms only location and standing. The Komoot visitor listing is the only source for the probable fire use and the no-climb note; both are unverified and worded that way in the story. Two DNR Sand Dunes pages were read and did not mention the tower. The agency value 34N-27-22 looks like a survey location code, so a correction is proposed. The visitor listing places the tower in the Uncas Dunes SNA, which the editor may want to confirm against the DNR's SNA description.
